# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest released version (GitHub Releases tag) receives security
fixes. The shell repackages upstream `@deepseek-ai/dsh` under MIT; issues
in the harness itself should be reported upstream.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for a vulnerability. Report it
privately instead:

- Email the maintainer via the repository contact (see the profile of the
  repository owner), or
- Open a private report with the "Report a vulnerability" button next to
  "New Issue" when this is enabled for the repository.

Include: affected version, platform, the exact steps to reproduce, and a
diagnostic report exported from the app (Help → Export diagnostics):
it masks common secrets and home paths — double check before sending any
attachments.

## Disclosure

We acknowledge all reports within 72 hours, coordinate a fix in a
security release, and credit the reporter unless they prefer anonymity.
We do not publish details until a fix is out; after the release the
findings are noted in the HANDOFF release section.
